text:
🚨 Bitcoin -20% de la nominalizarea lui Kevin Warsh la Fed

De la momentul în care Kevin Warsh a fost anunțat ca viitor șef al Fed, Bitcoin a scăzut aproximativ 20%.

Nu e o coincidență ignorabilă.

Context

Warsh este perceput ca:
• mai disciplinat monetar
• critic față de QE
• orientat spre stabilitate a prețurilor
• mai puțin tolerant cu bule speculative

Piața a interpretat mesajul ca:
👉 politică monetară mai dură pe termen lung

Crypto trăiește din lichiditate.
Orice semnal de „Fed mai strict” lovește activele de risc primele.

Ce e important

Nu înseamnă că Warsh e „bearish pentru crypto”.
Înseamnă că piața încearcă să recalculeze așteptările:

→ dobânzi mai ridicate mai mult timp
→ lichiditate mai scumpă
→ capital mai selectiv

Mișcarea e macro, nu doar crypto.

📌 Corecțiile mari apar exact când narațiunea se schimbă.

🔔 Urmărește @cryptoaici pentru explicații clare despre legătura dintre Fed, macro și crypto — fără zgomot, fără panică.

text:
That framing cherry-picks the worst possible entry and the shortest possible window.

Bitcoin isn’t a trade measured from one local top. It’s a monetary asset measured across cycles. If you bought at the 2013 top, 2017 top, or even the 2021 top and held through a full cycle, your purchasing power is higher today than it was then in almost every meaningful denominator except one hand-picked moment.

Gold looks good when you zoom into selective windows. Zoom out and it has spent decades preserving value, not compounding it. Bitcoin has spent 15 years doing the opposite, with brutal volatility along the way.

Short-term pain does not invalidate a long-term monetary thesis. It just exposes time preference.

Congrats to anyone who can hold gold without checking the price. Bitcoin rewards the same mindset, just on a shorter and louder timeline.

It’s all happening both in the spotlight and behind the scenes. We are all waiting on clarity. Billion dollar players won’t plow all in until they know the rules of engagement. Institutions are quietly accumulating and retail is selling as sentiment is at all time lows. Now is the time to level in. So what’s dragging us down? Unfortunately right now we are tied to the giant anchor of Bitcoin. It’s selling off and I’m not sure it will ever return to its highs. It doesn’t do anything. It’s clearly not a store of value and doesn’t hold a candle to XRP’s utility. Look at this as a 5-10 year play. You have to be able to stomach some uncomfortable times to be able to bask in the glory when this all comes together. Brad is on record saying this year if things lign up we will be seeing new ATH. He was careful about his words and said “crypto” but this was him being careful what to say and not say. There will be a major liquidity transfer going forward in this space. Those projects that don’t solve problems and don’t have a utility case in the “new financial system” will all go to zero or close…… including possibly Bitcoin (what does it do again? Keep doing the research and block out the noise.

text: Bitcoin versus Gold have come under pressure at the same time, which is unusual, but for completely different reasons. Gold is in a strong up trend, but the price has moved above reality and is overbought. Bitcoin is in a downtrend, along with tech, and is now oversold. One Bitcoin now buys 14.5 ounces of gold. Gold has the narrative, and central bank support, but Bitcoin has become the opportunity. Bitcoin is likely to remain correlated with tech, but when the turn comes, it has the potential to rise much faster. Gold remains in high demand, but the central banks will not chase it, and the bulls are tired. Interesting times for the contrarians.
